name: Promise-to-Pay Tracker Agent
fn: Tracks payment promises, triggers follow-up on broken promises, updates worklist
detail: Extracts payment promises from calls and emails, tracks them to the promised date and re-escalates broken promises into the worklist. Makes promise-to-pay a managed, measurable pipeline.
sap: SAP FSCM-COL · dunning programme F150 · FI-AR aging (FBL5N) · customer master (KNA1 / KNB1 / KNVV)

io.in: AR aging · customer master · comms history
io.out: Ranked worklist · dunning · promises · cash forecast
